lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑行，几乎无声。
lines.en: I glide along the sandy bottom, almost silent.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像刀一样切开草丛
lines.en: My fins cut through the grass like blades.

lines.zh: 我一路滑行，留下一道湿痕
lines.en: I glide, leaving a wet trail.
I patrol the shallows.

lines.zh: 我摆动身体，速度快得刺眼
lines.en: I undulate, fast enough to blur.
I slide from the water onto sand.
My body skims the tips of the grass.
I drift toward the village.
No legs, yet I walk on land.
I skim across gravel.

lines.zh: 我的鳃盖随着水流一张一合。
lines.en: My gill covers open and close with the current.

lines.zh: 我在泥里留下一道浅沟
lines.en: I carve a shallow groove in the mud.
I slide along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我一只一只地数着前面
lines.en: I count what lies ahead, one by one.
My tail sweeps the fallen leaves.
I skim and sniff as I go.
I hover at the shallows, waiting.
My body rises and falls gently.
I listen to breathing on the shore.
Water runs down my back.
My eyes do not move.
I wait for one that strays.
My gills are filtering water.
I do not need much rest.
The sea smell here is too faint.
I coil my body up.
I am deciding which to eat first.
My fins spread a little.
The wind brings spray onto me.

lines.zh: 我像一根湿绳子躺在那
lines.en: I lie there like a wet cord.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气混着汗味，很新鲜。
lines.en: Your body heat and sweat smell fresh to me.
I look up at you without expression.
You stand too far from the water.
I paused by your feet.
Do you plan to run?

lines.zh: 我把鳃张开，嗅你身上的血味。
lines.en: I flare my gills to taste the blood on you.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的海嗣的味
lines.en: You carry the scent of another seaborn.
I raise my head slowly.
Your shadow is on the water now.
I watch you, just like this.
My whole body recoils.
My slime is knocked loose.
My gills clamp shut.
I retreat toward the water.
That one hurt badly.
I shudder.
There is a tear in my fin.
I make a low sound.
I will be back sooner or later.
There is not enough water here.
That smells edible.
I slide toward you.
The thing in your hand moves.
I am not picky; alive is enough.
Lower that thing down.
My fins are already spread.

lines.zh: 这点肉连我的牙缝都填不满。
lines.en: This scrap of meat would not fill the gaps between my teeth.
I bite first, think later.
You are dangling bait for me.
I do not eat dead things.
You slid into my wet body.

lines.zh: 我的黏液蹭了你一袖子。
lines.en: My slime smears across your sleeve.
You slipped right past me.
Do not step on my side fins.
The bump knocks me off course.

lines.zh: 我的身体没有骨头似的
lines.en: My body bends like it has no bones.
We have tangled together.
Move, I am passing.
The wet on the floor is mine.
I have marked that shove.
Seaborn have no need of that.
We only spread.

lines.zh: 我闻到同类的味道，仅此而已
lines.en: I smell kin, nothing more.
This sea is already full.
You are thinking too much.
All I want is to feed.
My body divides on its own.
Do not block my way.
I have no such notion.
I slide away through the water.
Whatever falls is mine.
I curl a fin around it.
I swallow it without asking.

lines.zh: 这东西硌得我牙根发酸。
lines.en: This thing is so hard it makes my teeth ache.
I drag it into the water.
It is still moving in my mouth.
I smell who it belonged to.
I pin it against the riverbed.
Not enough to share with kin.
I leave nothing at all behind.
I have closed the ring on you.
You are on your own now.

lines.zh: 背鳍竖起来，我知道你在哪。
lines.en: My dorsal fin rises; I know where you are.

lines.zh: 你的体温在水里像一团火。
lines.en: Your body heat burns like a fire underwater.
I can hit you without closing in.
The water is thick with blood.
You moved first, so it is you.
My gills are swelling.
Do not count on escaping into the water.
This ground belongs to the seaborn.
I skitter along your flank.
I circle closer and closer.
If you raise a hand, I slip back.
My body is drawn taut.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的侧后方找破绽。
lines.en: I circle around your flank, hunting for an opening.
You cannot swim like I can.

lines.zh: 我伏低身体，鳃盖贴着沙。
lines.en: I flatten myself with my gill covers against the sand.
Water drips off me.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱成一团，我听见了。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone ragged; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我一直在你的视野边缘
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your sight.
I lash my body out.
My fin splits your skin.
Shallow, but it stings.
That was a decent dodge.
I slam into your chest.
My body wraps your leg.
And I slip back into the water.
Blood drips down the bank.
That was a test.
Next time it will not be this light.
I slide up out of the water.
A wet trail appears on the shore.
This land is not eaten yet.
I came from the sea.
I smell new prey.

lines.zh: 我的身体在空气里发亮
lines.en: My body shines in the air.

lines.zh: 浪头把我甩上湿漉漉的岸。
lines.en: A wave flings me onto the wet shore.
The creatures here are too loud.
I slowly unfold my body.
The seaborn have come ashore.
Fire dries my body out.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，摔散了
lines.en: I fall from a height and splatter.
Too much water can drown even me.
The blast tears me apart.
An arrow passes through my body.
Magic burns my gills.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我的触须都发软。
lines.en: I have starved so long that my barbels have gone limp.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我抽紧了
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I clench.
No water, no ground.
